Method of Attack: Fileless delivery using Microsoft Build Engine (MSBuild) to deploy remote access tools (RATs) and information-stealing malware
Bundled encoded executables and shellcode injected into memory of newly spawned processes
Stealing credentials, keystrokes, screen snapshots, disabling anti-malware, gaining persistence, full device takeover
Scanning for web browsers, messaging apps, VPN and cryptocurrency software to steal user credentials and crypto wallet info
Impacted Systems: Windows systems capable of running MSBuild
Attack Vector: Malicious MSBuild project files (.proj) executed via msbuild.exe
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious MSBuild project files delivering encoded executables and shellcode
Fileless malware delivery with no files written to disk
